note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the .do builds item = "P701C_" + string(L07A), a number-preserving rename of REG07A's own line code (core model s3 pattern 2). The data dictionary's value labels for L07A tie lines 1..20 to the questionnaire's rows 1..20 ('la han ignorado, no la han tomado en cuenta o no le han demostrado afecto?' = 1 ... 'la han agredido con armas de fuego...' = 20), 20/20 in the questionnaire's order. RESP: the .do sets 9 (NR) to missing and recodes (6=1)(1=2), so source 1 Sí / 6 No becomes live 1 = No, 2 = Sí; option_text is keyed to the LIVE codes (1 No, 2 Sí). Route 9: raw REG07A counts recoded equal live resp 1/2 in 40/40 item x resp cells; the unrecoded reading matches 0/40. Live 1/2 per line: 1 2660/615, 2 2439/835, 3 2971/304, 4 3135/141, 5 3231/44, 6 3204/72, 7 3246/28, 8 2905/371, 9 3159/116, 10 3131/144, 11 3246/30, 12 3025/251, 13 1933/1341, 14 3115/161, 15 3268/8, 16 3263/13, 17 3225/50, 18 3154/122, 19 3217/57, 20 3223/52 (raw No/Sí identical). Dropped NR (9): 15 rows (lines 1,2,3,5,7,9,10,13,17,19,20: 1,2,1,1,2,1,1,2,1,2,1). Raw 65520 = 3276 women x 20; live 65505 rows, 3276 ids, no pooling of registers. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (20 items, resp {1,2}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = the questionnaire's shared 701 stem 'Dígame si a lo largo de su vida ¿Algunas personas de su familia sin incluir a su esposo, cónyuge, pareja o novio...' joined to each row's text with the row number and its own leading ellipsis dropped (same convention as the batch_601 sibling; the manual: 'el llenado de la pregunta 701 es en forma vertical desde el 1 al 20'). Line-wrap hyphens joined in rows 7 (algu-na), 9 (aban-donado), 15 (propó-sito), 18 (obliga-do), 19 (sexua-les); the dictionary labels confirm each joined word. Row 11's capital 'Le han enviado' is kept as printed. The questionnaire is shipped where it differs from the dictionary labels: row 5 'sus documentos personales' (dict omits 'sus'), row 11 'vídeos' (dict 'videos'), row 16 'la han convencido' (dict 'le han'), row 20 'armas de fuego' (dict 'fuegos'). instructions = the Sección VII read-aloud text without 'ENCUESTADORA, léale lo siguiente a la entrevistada:' and the quotation marks; 'pare-ja' joined; manual pp.72 prints the same wording. option_text = the questionnaire's 701 codes 'Sí.... 1' / 'No.... 6' verbatim (Sí, No); no row for NR 9. Follow-ups 702-706 (perpetrator, place, frequency, severity, last 12 months) are not in this table. Single section_id, no section_prompt. The questionnaire's 707F filter says 'AL MENOS UNO DE LOS 18 TEMAS' although 701 has 20 rows; not a table issue. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INE publishes the ENSIMUP in Spanish only; all English produced by IRW. Issues-page entry owed once live.
